name: SvelteKit Patterns
description: SvelteKit — runes, server-side load functions, form actions, progressive enhancement, $effect patterns
content:
# SvelteKit Patterns

- Use Svelte 5 runes (`$state`, `$derived`, `$effect`) for reactivity — avoid legacy `$:` reactive statements
- Load data in `+page.server.ts` or `+page.ts` `load` functions — never fetch data inside components directly
- Use form actions (`+page.server.ts` actions) for mutations — they work without JavaScript for progressive enhancement
- Keep `$effect` side effects minimal and focused — avoid writing to `$state` inside `$effect` to prevent infinite loops
- Use `$derived` for computed values instead of manually syncing state in effects
- Implement proper error handling with `+error.svelte` pages and `error()` helper from `@sveltejs/kit`
- Use `+layout.ts` and `+layout.server.ts` for shared data loading — avoid prop drilling through component trees
- Enable prerendering (`export const prerender = true`) for static pages to improve performance and SEO
- Use SvelteKit's built-in `$env/static/private` and `$env/static/public` for environment variables — never expose server secrets to the client
- Validate form data on the server with libraries like Zod in form actions — never trust client-side validation alone
